Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action

Class RepetitionOptions

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.RepetitionOptions
public final class RepetitionOptions extends Object
Configuration for action repetition and pausing behavior.

This class encapsulates all parameters for controlling how many times an action or a sequence of actions is repeated, and the pauses between those repetitions. It distinguishes between an "individual action" (e.g., a single click on one match) and an "action sequence" (e.g., clicking on all matches found).

It is an immutable object designed to be composed within other Options classes.

    • getTimesToRepeatIndividualAction

      public int getTimesToRepeatIndividualAction()
      The number of times to repeat an action on an individual target.

      For example, when clicking on a match, this value determines how many consecutive clicks are performed on that single match before moving to the next one.

    • getMaxTimesToRepeatActionSequence

      public int getMaxTimesToRepeatActionSequence()
      The maximum number of times to repeat a full action sequence.

      An action sequence comprises all activities in one iteration of a basic action, such as clicking on all found matches. The sequence will stop when it is successful or when this maximum is reached.

    • getPauseBetweenIndividualActions

      public double getPauseBetweenIndividualActions()
      The pause, in seconds, between repetitions on individual targets.

      The pause, in seconds, between repetitions of the entire action sequence.
